patches.value: positive integer k maps to Euclidean/Borel/Lebesgue measure space on ℝᵏ

For each positive integer k, identify ℝᵏ with the finite product Fin k→ℝ, equip it with its Euclidean norm and topology, the Borel σ-algebra generated by that topology, and product Lebesgue measure (the product of one-dimensional Lebesgue volume on each coordinate).
